(i) Lipoplatin™ is a highly neurotoxic agent when given intracerebrally by convection enhanced delivery and that (ii) CHEMS liposomes are a promising agent for the treatment of glioma but that further refinement of the formulation will be required before it can be used for treatment of brain tumors.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel liposomal formulations that may be suitable for i.c. administration of anticancer agents by CED.
developing new therapeutic agents for the treatment of gliomas and related brain tumors.
the development of liposomal cisplatin for the treatment of malignant glioma.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
neither Lipoplatin™ nor CHEMS liposomes are suitable for i.c. administration by CED for brain tumor therapy.
neither formulation of cisplatinal liposomes tested in this study is suitable for clinical use in the treatment of malignant brain tumors.
cisplatin is not an ideal agent for treatment of brain tumors by convection enhanced delivery.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the CHEMS liposomal cisplatin formulation was the most promising of the three liposome preparations for treatment of brain tumor, however, the neurotoxicity observed with the liposomal formulations was unexpected.

the CHEMS liposomes have a high Pt loading, are highly cytotoxic to F98 cells in vitro, show good tumor retention in vivo, are clinically well tolerated when given by CED and are not neurotoxic at the dose levels tested.
the CHEMS liposomal preparation is more potent in vitro and in vivo than free cisplatinum and is a potential candidate for clinical testing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the neurotoxicity of cisplatin is highly dependent upon its formulation.
the neurotoxicity of the cisplatin liposomal formulations is related to the lipid components of the liposomes themselves and not to the cisplatin.
the neurotoxicity of liposomal cisplatin is dose dependent and can vary depending on the type of liposome and its composition.
